name: slack_list_channels
description: List public or pre-defined channels in the workspace with pagination

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return (default 100, max 200)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

name: slack_post_message
description: Post a new message to a Slack channel

channel_id.description: The ID of the channel to post to

name: slack_reply_to_thread
description: Reply to a specific message thread in Slack

channel_id.description: The ID of the channel containing the thread

thread_ts.description: The timestamp of the parent message in the format '1234567890.123456'. Timestamps in the format without the period can be converted by adding the period such that 6 numbers come after it.

name: slack_add_reaction
description: Add a reaction emoji to a message

channel_id.description: The ID of the channel containing the message

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the message to react to

reaction.description: The name of the emoji reaction (without ::)

name: slack_get_channel_history
description: Get recent messages from a channel

name: slack_get_thread_replies
description: Get all replies in a message thread

channel_id.description: The ID of the channel containing the thread

thread_ts.description: The timestamp of the parent message in the format '1234567890.123456'.

name: slack_get_users
description: Get a list of all users in the workspace with their basic profile information

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return (default 100, max 200)

name: slack_get_user_profile
description: Get detailed profile information for a specific user

name: slack_search_messages
description: Search for messages across channels the user can access. Supports Slack search modifiers such as in:#channel, from:@user, before: and after:.

query.description: Search query, with optional Slack modifiers

name: slack_create_channel
description: Create a new public or private Slack channel

name: slack_schedule_message
description: Schedule a message to be sent to a channel at a later time

post_at.description: Unix timestamp for when the message should be sent

name: slack_upload_file
description: Upload a file and share it in a channel

channel_id.description: The ID of the channel to share the file in

name: slack_set_channel_topic
description: Set the topic of a channel

name: slack_invite_to_channel
description: Invite one or more users to a channel

users.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to invite
